blocks.text: Ilha Grande: private boat, beaches and dolphin watching

provenance.rationale: Day heading summarising the private boat, beach stops and possible dolphin sightings.

blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to the Angra dos Reis region (about 3.5 hours from Rio)  

A full-day trip on a private boat awaits you,  stopping  at the best beaches on the island. You will see unique landscapes! The Emerald Sea and many picturesque islets scattered around the bay. Very often you can see frolicking dolphins, giant fish, and turtles. In the sea, the schooner stops so that those who wish can swim.

After that, you will be dropped off at the port of Angra dos Reis, where the driver will meet you and take you to Rio

blocks.text: Free day and New Year's Eve on Copacabana

provenance.rationale: Heading follows the 31 December date, optional daytime tours and New Year's Eve dinner on Copacabana.

blocks.text:
Time for optional tour

Boat trip, ocean fishing, Botanical Garden walk, Tijuca Forest Tour, Modern and Historic Center Tour

We advise you to have a good rest and prepare for the New Year. 

In the evening, an unforgettable holiday awaits you on the beach of Copacabana! New Year in Rio is a grand event not only for tourists, but also for locals.  It is launched on Copacabana beach from platforms located directly in the water. Residents of Brazil celebrate the New Year in white clothes. Believers pay tribute to the goddess of water Imanja. They put their gifts in tiny boats and send them to the ocean. And all this to the lights of fireworks falling into the water. The spectacle is truly mesmerizing! Also on the beach there are podiums for the performance of famous artists, who can be listened to this night by anyone - the concert is free! The fun continues all night. 

VIP New Year's Eve dinner in Belmond included.
